# SurajWood (Suraj Wood Products Pvt. Ltd.)

> India's premier manufacturer of prelaminated PMMA acrylic panels, 3D membrane shutters, and architectural aluminum profiles.

SurajWood is a factory-direct architectural surface manufacturer based in Bahadurgarh, Haryana, India. We specialize in optical-grade PMMA acrylic sheets bonded with German Polyurethane Reactive (PUR) hotmelt technology for zero delamination, 3H scratch resistance, and 10-year UV color fastness.

## Product Portfolio

- [ACRYLUX High-Gloss](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acrylux): Flagship high-gloss prelaminated acrylic panel with 37+ solid, metallic, and wood-grain colors.
- [ACRYSILK Soft-Satin](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acrysilk): Micro-textured soft satin acrylic surface with advanced anti-fingerprint protection.
- [ACRYMATTE Nano-Matte](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acrymatte): Deep matte acrylic panels featuring German nano anti-fingerprint coating.
- [ACRYGLASS High-Gloss](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acryglass): Mirror-like high-gloss acrylic panels offering 95% light reflectivity and glass-like depth.
- [ACRYGLASS MATTE](https://www.surajwood.com/products/acryglass-matte): Optical-grade glass clarity combined with a velvety matte surface.
- [3D Membrane Shutters](https://www.surajwood.com/products/membrane-shutters): Seamless 3D membrane wrapped shutters for modular kitchens and wardrobes.
- [AL-PROFHAN Aluminum Profiles](https://www.surajwood.com/products/aluminum-profiles): European-standard profile handles, glass shutters, and architectural hardware.

## Applications

- [Modular Kitchens](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/kitchens): Moisture-proof, Class B1 fire-rated panels engineered for heavy Indian cooking.
- [Luxury Wardrobes](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/wardrobes): Anti-fingerprint, 3H hardness surfaces for sliding and hinged wardrobe doors.
- [Bathroom Vanities](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/bathroom-vanities): 100% waterproof PUR-bonded panels resistant to steam, splash, and mold.
- [TV Units & Consoles](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/tv-units): High-gloss and matte living room media backdrops.
- [Commercial & Retail](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/commercial): Durable, high-traffic surfaces for corporate offices, reception desks, and boutiques.
- [Architectural Wall Paneling](https://www.surajwood.com/applications/wall-paneling): Large-format 8ft x 4ft seamless wall cladding.

## Technical Specifications

- **Surface Layer**: 1.0mm – 1.5mm Optical-Grade PMMA (Polymethyl Methacrylate).
- **Core Substrates**: E1-Grade Low-Formaldehyde MDF, Calibrated Plywood, Particle Board (PB).
- **Adhesive Bonding**: 100% German Polyurethane Reactive (PUR) Hotmelt (waterproof & heat resistant to 120°C).
- **Scratch Hardness**: 3H Pencil Hardness.
- **Fire Rating**: Class B1 (DIN 4102).
- **Standard Dimensions**: 8ft × 4ft (2440mm × 1220mm); Thicknesses: 8mm, 18mm, 25mm.
- **Warranty**: 5-Year Manufacturer Warranty against delamination, bubbling, and color degradation.
